selection_jql: project = TC AND status = Open ORDER BY priority DESC, updated ASC

review.primary: claude -p "Review ticket {issue_key}. Respond PASS or FAIL only."
review.fallback: codex "Review ticket {issue_key}. Respond PASS or FAIL only."

comments.start: Auto manager started work on {issue_key} with {assignee_name} on {date}.
comments.done: Auto manager review PASS on {date}. Completed by {assignee_name}.
comments.fail: Auto manager review FAIL on {date}. Review output: {review_output}
comments.implement_fail: Auto manager implementation command failed on {date}. Output: {implement_output}
